project.name: landing
project.description: The local merge queue that lands changes on main: one integrator, chosen by an OS lock, verifies each squashed request on the main it will land on and pushes it. Depends on no other module of the project and none depends on it, so the installed tool never runs the code it gatekeeps. No Spring, no Netty; Jackson for the journal. Code outside the package landing.shell, kept for the module's shell, does no I/O and reads no ambient clock or environment - enforced by the ArchUnit rules in the app module.
